I am farming this maize plot on rented land here in Benshangul Gumuz, so I must be careful with money I spend because the land is not mine. The rains usually come well enough here, so I do not irrigate — I depend on the season. I will buy a small amount of DAP and urea if I can get it from the cooperative, but only a modest dose because fertilizer is expensive and I am still young and building up. My wife and I will do most of the weeding ourselves, but at planting and harvest I will call a few people from the village to help for a small payment or food.
